text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Today's training is all done!
I'm sooo tired! And so hungry—!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, let's go eat!
Today is chanko stew packed with chicken meatballs!
I prepped everything this morning☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
I'm so full!
The miso soaked in so well, it was delicious~!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
The finale rice porridge was amazing too...
Yep, thanks for the happy feast☆

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey!
This is really incredible, isn't it?
It's all thanks to you, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Enjoying a delicious meal
after training!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
You know, they say when you're overly exhausted,
you can end up losing your appetite entirely.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I'm completely fine!
Even when I'm super tired,
I can still eat a whole bunch of tasty food!”

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
My belly was full, and I was so happy and having fun...
Feeling like that made me able to focus on all kinds of things!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
Does this mean
training is going really well?
choice_data_list: I'd be glad if that's the case.

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
That's definitely it!
In that case, it really is all thanks to you, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Hishi Akebono
text_block_list.text:
"Thanks for everything as always, Trainer!
I'll keep eating lots and lots of food
and doing my best, okay? ☆"
